supersedes.reason: Pre-migration anchor, built when the design lib was a separate checkout outside this repo. It is NOT reproducible: svelte's default cssHash is hash(filename) and vite-plugin-svelte passes the RAW ABSOLUTE id, so that sha was a function of one machine's directory layout and any agent building in its own worktree got a different one with zero content change. The migration pins cssHash to hash(css) (vite.config.mjs), making the artifact path-independent and reproducible by anyone. Equivalence to this anchor was proven, not assumed: CSS byte-identical after scope-hash normalisation (45216 == 45216), whole-artifact length identical after normalisation (405241 == 405241), visible-text multiset identical, and an A/B/A control showed the submodule mount + dropped npm dep + vite rewrite reproduce b7fc6483 EXACTLY when the design root is pointed back at the old path.
